newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens transport unit aims to break even.
newsitem.headline: Siemens transport unit aims to break even.

text.p: The transportation unit of electronics and engineering giant Siemens AG still aims to break even in the current business year ending September 30, board member Horst Langer said on Friday.
"Normally we realise our goals," Langer told Reuters.
Rationalisation measures in the division have largely been implemented, said Langer, who was unveiling the second generation of Siemens ICE high-speed trains.

The division lost 128 million marks last fiscal year. Sales have grown 370 percent in the past six years, and it is pinning great hopes on the new trains, which have a maximum speed of 280 kilometers per hour.
The first of the new trains was being handed over to Deutsche Bahn AG, which has ordered 44 of the new trains for 1.6 billion marks.
